file.notApplied: The settings file on disk is not applied

auth.accountDetail: Your name, password and second factors.
auth.membersDetail: Who works in Invoices, and their role: viewers see everything, editors make and issue invoices, record payments and import statements, admins also manage members and tokens.
auth.signinDetail: How people sign in: passwords, and identity providers with OIDC.
auth.tokensDetail: Tokens for scripts and other products, each with a role and an end date. Time needs one with the editor role, Audience's erasures one with the admin role.

statusMeans.queued: Numbered and on its way to the integrator
statusMeans.waiting: The integrator sent it; GİB has not answered yet
statusMeans.accepted: The buyer accepted the commercial invoice
statusMeans.rejected: The buyer refused it within eight days
statusMeans.refused: Stopped before GİB; fix it and send it again under its number
statusMeans.failed: GİB failed it; fix it and send it again under its number
statusMeans.cancelled: An e-Arşiv invoice cancelled through the integrator

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: What customers owe and what is late, in {{currency}}; invoices in other currencies count at the TCMB rate they were issued at.
overview.daysToPayNone: Invoices paid in the last 90 days
overview.byMonthDetail: By issue month, without KDV: paid and still owed
overview.byMonthLabel: Invoiced by month, paid and owed

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.description: Invoices and credit notes, with their state at GİB and what is left to pay. One series per channel and year: {{eFatura}} for e-Fatura, {{eArsiv}} for e-Arşiv.

invoice.title: Invoice {{number}}
invoice.reminded: Reminder emailed to {{to}} with the PDF and the XML.
invoice.refusedDetail: Nothing reached GİB, so the invoice can be fixed and sent again under the same number.
invoice.retrying_one: The integrator could not be reached; tried {{count}} time, trying again
invoice.retrying_other: The integrator could not be reached; tried {{count}} times, trying again
invoice.paymentRemoved: Payment removed; what is owed is back.
invoice.remindersDetail: Days in invoices.yaml, sent while it is unpaid
invoice.noMail: No mail server is set in invoices.yaml, so no reminder goes out.

steps.label: Sending
steps.eightDays: The buyer has eight days to answer

pay.title: Record a payment for {{number}}
pay.detail: Left to pay: {{amount}}. A part payment leaves the rest owed.
pay.wrongAmount: Write the amount as a number, such as 1500 or 1.500,50.
pay.full: Paid in full. Reminders for {{number}} are stopped.

credit.title: Credit note for {{number}}
credit.detail: A sent invoice is never changed. The credit note is an IADE invoice that names this one; it is drafted, then issued like any invoice.
credit.body: The draft starts with every line of {{number}}. Take out what stays, or lower the quantities, before you issue it.

cancel.title: Cancel {{number}}?
cancel.detail: An e-Arşiv invoice with no payments is cancelled through the integrator. Its number stays used, and its goods come back to the stock.

again.detail: It goes to the integrator again under the same number and date, with a new ETTN. Fix the customer or the lines first if that is what the integrator refused.

editor.deleteDetail: A draft has no number, so nothing is skipped. Billable items on it are free again.
editor.noLines: No lines yet. Add one from your products, or write one in.
editor.name: Line {{n}}: what it is
editor.lineWrong: Line {{n}}: write the quantity and the price as numbers.
editor.channelEArsiv: Not an e-Fatura user: goes as e-Arşiv, with the PDF by email
editor.channelUnknown: Not checked yet: goes as e-Arşiv unless the integrator says otherwise when it is issued
editor.channelCredit: Goes as {{channel}}, like the invoice it corrects
editor.customerMissing: The customer needs its tax number, tax office and district before issuing.
editor.nextNumber: Next number: {{number}}, given only when it is issued.
editor.rateNote: Issued at TCMB's rate of the last bulletin before its day.
editor.beforeIssueDetail: The UBL-TR XML is checked first. Once issued, the invoice is never changed; a credit note corrects it.
editor.confirmDetail: {{channel}} to {{customer}}, {{amount}} to pay. It goes to {{integrator}} now and is emailed with its PDF.
editor.numberCaveat: The integrator is asked again whether the buyer is an e-Fatura user; if that changed, the number is from the other series.

customers.title: Customers
customers.description: Who you invoice, with their tax number and office, payment terms and currency. A won deal in CRM brings its company here.
customers.formDetail: A change here changes no invoice already issued: each keeps the buyer as they were.
customers.name: Name
customers.taxIdHint: 10 digits for a company, 11 for a person; 11111111111 for a person who gives none
customers.eFaturaHelp: Whether GİB lists them as an e-Fatura user, asked through the integrator. Others get e-Arşiv.
customers.checkName: Check whether {{name}} is an e-Fatura user
customers.isUser: {{name}} is an e-Fatura user. Their invoices go as e-Fatura from now on.
customers.notUser: {{name}} is not an e-Fatura user. Their invoices go as e-Arşiv, with the PDF by email.
customers.none: No customers yet. Add one, or import a CSV file.
customers.csvHelp: CSV import: a header row with name, tax_id, tax_office, street, district, city, postal_code, country, email, phone, currency, payment_days, notes. A row with a known tax number changes that customer.

products.title: Products
products.description: Products and services with their unit, price and KDV. A product on an issued invoice is taken off the list, not deleted.
products.wrongPrice: Write the price as a number, such as 2400 or 2.400,50.
products.stockHint: Issuing moves them out of the stock; a credit note brings them back.
products.showRemoved: Show what is off the list
products.none: No products yet. Add one, or import a CSV file.
products.csvHelp: CSV import: a header row with code, name, unit, unit_price, currency, kdv_rate, withholding, exemption, stock. A row with a known code changes that product.

import.failed_one: Nothing was imported: {{count}} row is wrong
import.failed_other: Nothing was imported: {{count}} rows are wrong

recurring.title: Recurring
recurring.label: Recurring invoices
recurring.description: Invoices made every few months from the same lines. Each is issued on its day, or kept as a draft for someone to check first.
recurring.formDetail: On its day an invoice is made with the period it covers; the 31st is the last day of shorter months.
recurring.removed: {{name}} is deleted; invoices it made stay.
recurring.name: Name
recurring.nameHint: Only for you, such as Support, monthly
recurring.startHint: The first invoice is made on this day
recurring.endHint: Left empty: until it is stopped

bank.title: Bank
bank.description: Statements imported from your bank. A line that names an invoice number, or pays exactly what a customer owes and names them, is matched by itself; the rest wait for you.
bank.imported: {{file}}: {{added}} new lines, {{matched}} matched, {{unmatched}} waiting for you, {{duplicates}} seen before.
bank.noLines: No lines yet. Import a statement.
bank.nothingOwed: No invoice in this currency is owed.
bank.matchedFull: Matched to {{number}}. It is paid in full.
bank.noAccountsDetail: Name your accounts and the columns of their statements under bank in invoices.yaml; then statements are imported here.

exports.title: Exports
exports.description: For your accountant. Invoices does not keep the books; these files go into the accountant's program. CSV with ; and a decimal comma, as Excel in Turkish reads it.
exports.invoicesDetail: Every issued invoice and credit note: number, date, customer, VKN, net, KDV by rate, tevkifat, total.
exports.paymentsDetail: Payments received, with the invoice each one paid.
exports.ublDetail: The UBL-TR XML of each invoice as it went to the integrator.

rate.forex_buying: TCMB's forex buying rate of the last bulletin before the invoice's day
rate.forex_selling: TCMB's forex selling rate of the last bulletin before the invoice's day
rate.banknote_buying: TCMB's banknote buying rate of the last bulletin before the invoice's day
rate.banknote_selling: TCMB's banknote selling rate of the last bulletin before the invoice's day

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: The GİB integrator invoices go through, the services Invoices reads, and what other OpenAsy products call. Everything is set in invoices.yaml.
integrations.integratorDetail: Signs and sends each invoice to GİB, answers whether a buyer is an e-Fatura user, and cancels e-Arşiv invoices. Invoices is not an integrator itself.
integrations.fakeDetail: Nothing is sent to GİB. Use it to try Invoices.
integrations.keyMissingDetail: The variable api_key names is empty.
integrations.noSeller: The seller is not set in the file, so nothing can be issued.
integrations.tcmb: Exchange rates for invoices in other currencies.
integrations.mailDetail: Issued invoices and reminders go out by email with the PDF.
integrations.noEmailOnIssue: Issued invoices are not emailed by themselves
integrations.crm: Won deals become draft invoices, with their company as the customer.
integrations.wonDraft: Each deal won becomes a draft invoice
integrations.wonOff: Won deals are drafted only by hand
integrations.bankDetail: Statements imported as CSV or MT940 and matched to invoices.
integrations.timeDetail: Approved billable hours wait here for an invoice.
integrations.billable_one: {{count}} billable item waits for an invoice.
integrations.billable_other: {{count}} billable items wait for an invoice.
integrations.helpdeskDetail: Shows a customer's invoices and what they owe beside a billing question.
integrations.inventoryDetail: Reads goods that left with an invoice and came back with a credit note.
integrations.erasureDetail: Deletes a person on request. Issued invoices are kept for ten years (VUK 253, TTK 82).

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: The seller, numbers, taxes, the integrator and how money is collected, as {{file}} sets them.
settings.readOnlyDetail: Change them in the file and review the change like code; Invoices reads it again within a minute. A file with a mistake leaves the last good version in place.
settings.noFile: No settings file: the defaults are in use, and nothing can be issued.
settings.sellerUnset: Not set: nothing can be issued
settings.seriesValue: {{eFatura}} for e-Fatura, {{eArsiv}} for e-Arşiv; each starts again at 1 every year
settings.termsValue: {{days}} days unless the customer has their own
settings.remindersValue: {{before}} days before the due day; {{after}} days after, at {{at}}
